text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered - HIGH - inference-gateway-usw2: sustained 5xx spike (>8% error rate over 2m). PD ID: PD-98321. Runbook: https://runbooks/internal/inference-5xx

mike_oncall: acked PD-98321 :white_check_mark: taking lead. brief summary?

incident-bot: auto-check: region=usw2, upstream=kv-cache-proxy, error=502/503, recent deploy=no, traffic shift=+12% to canary slice.

aly_sre: seeing digests - kvcache eviction counters jumped, backend svc responded 5xx while cache was cold. Traces show queueing at ingress for ~200ms then 502.

devin_runtime: confirming - autoscaler didn't spin immediately because batch size spike. Suggest immediate mitigation: throttle canary, route 30% away from usw2, and warm kvcache.

mike_oncall: agreed. canary -> 0% ASAP. jordan_sre can you run route swap?

jordan_sre: on it. running route shift to fallback region (usw1) via traffic-router. Command: ```sh
./traffic-router shift --from=usw2 --to=usw1 --percent=30 --reason='PD-98321 5xx spike'
```

lucy_cs: FYI CS queue getting alerts from customers in EU about failures for embeddings. I flagged top 3 customers to AMs. No major revenue impact yet but visible.

aly_sre: warming kv caches on key pods now: ```kubectl exec -it kv-warm -- /bin/warmup.sh --keys=hot_keys_list.txt``` estimate 90s to populate.

devin_runtime: also enabling short-circuit fallback on gateway for cached keys: set header X-Bypass-KV: true for warm pods. Pushing small config: ```PATCH /gateway/config
{ "kvcache_fallback": "allow-short-circuit" }```

mike_oncall: status?

jordan_sre: traffic shift at 30% complete. monitoring 1m windows.

incident-bot: metric update: error_rate(usw2)=7.9% -> 5.1% after 30% shift. Latency p95 dropping.

aly_sre: eviction storm subsiding, background warm job completed on 6/8 pods. errors trending down.

mike_oncall: good. keep traffic shift until error_rate <1% for 5m. start plan for postmortem and customer communication. Severity S1? I think S2 since partial customer impact but mitigated quickly. Thoughts?

lucy_cs: S2 agreeable. I'll prepare a short CS blurb for affected customers and coordinate with AMs.

devin_runtime: adding temporary circuit-breaker tighter thresholds to avoid repeat. pushing config now.

jordan_sre: starting follow-up rollout to increase autoscale responsiveness for kv-proxy (lower cooldown). I'll open an ops ticket.

mike_oncall: final checks: any lingering 5xx traces?

aly_sre: a handful of recent traces show 502 at 1% of requests - likely residual. We'll keep watch.

incident-bot: PD-98321 auto-close condition: error_rate<1% for 10m and PD ack closed. Current: error_rate_usw2=0.9% (5m).

mike_oncall: I'll close PD once we hold for 10m and CS message is sent. thanks team :thumbsup:

lucy_cs: CS note sent to top-3 customers and support queue announcement posted. Link to draft: https://docs.internal/cs/pd-98321-note

mike_oncall: closing loop: rollback not required. action items: jordan - infra ticket to tune autoscale; devin - add short-circuit toggle to runbook; aly - include eviction metrics as playbook checklist; lucy - follow up customer check-ins. I'll file postmortem placeholder.

jordan_sre: noted, filing INFRA-1224.

devin_runtime: adding snippet to runbook now. PR: https://git.internal/r/runbooks/infra/pulls/45

aly_sre: will attach relevant graphs to postmortem.

mike_oncall: PD-98321 will be closed after 10m stable window. switching to monitoring-only. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

incident-bot: PD-98321 marked 'monitoring' by mike_oncall. final metric snapshot and tracing links attached to PD.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: PD-98321 auto-closed after stability window. Great work everyone.

mike_oncall: nice work. postmortem owners: mike_oncall (lead), aly_sre (investigation), devin_runtime (runtime fixes), jordan_sre (infra). I'll set timeline for draft in 48h.
